style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: ⟦0⟧, aka ⟦1⟧, can be managed with national focuses, events and decisions providing bonuses to country or states.

Each country can have one balance of power at the same time with 2 sides: left and right. A BoP can be replaced only with another BoP from the same side -- for example, Benito Mussolini side can be replaced with Italo Balbo side, but not with Communist side.
Each side have multiple ranges, where range limit is from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧. Each balance of power have one middle range that isn't attached to any of the sides.
The middle point between all sides.
The Grand Council side is opposite to ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.
Total Control of the Grand Council
Motion of No Confidence in the Duce
